competencies: The learner critiques, produces and publishes prose pieces through analysing, writing, presenting or exhibiting in order to increase language proficiency, entertainment and for ethical edification and self-sustenance.

The learner critiques, writes, performs and publishes own poetry through reading and appreciating both its thematic concerns and stylistic effects; for entertainment, ethical edification and self-sustenance.

The learner writes, publishes and performs own drama/play through reading, analysing, critiquing and appreciating their work in order to inform, entertain; and for ethical edification and self-sustenance.
The learner writes, publishes own novella/short story through reading, appreciating and presenting/exhibiting in order to inform, entertain; and for ethical edification and self-sustenance.
values: honesty, uphold and defend them at all times
integrity; moral uprightness and sound character
attitudes: instill positive attitudes towards productive work and strong respect for the dignity of labour
develop a positive attitude towards learning as a lifelong process

themes.theme_description: Foundational understanding of literature, its forms, and functions in society.

suggested_learning_activities.description: Guide learners to think, pair and share: i) the meaning, forms and the importance of literature to society, ii) distinct features of prose (word, sentence, paragraphing). iii) the differences between prose and other genres of literature. iv) present their findings to plenary.
